Foam Party Rentals Nova Scotia

Nova Kingdom Rentals runs high-energy foam parties for kids' birthdays, school fun days, daycares, summer camps, and community events across Nova Scotia. We bring the foam machine, foam solution, and an operator — you provide a grass area, a water source, and power. Foam parties are for children's events only, with adult supervision required. Pricing is by guest count — see the FAQ below. We also offer an Inflatable Foam Pit option — a 13 ft × 13 ft pit with 3 ft side walls and a 6 ft back wall that keeps the foam in one contained play area, a great fit for smaller kids' parties and backyard-style events.

Based in Bridgewater, Nova Scotia. Kids foam parties are best suited to the South Shore, HRM, and nearby areas where foam logistics work well. Delivery extra. Final availability, travel, and setup suitability are confirmed manually for every foam booking.

Frequently Asked Questions

How much does a foam party cost?
Pricing is by guest count. Up to 30 kids: $349/hr standalone or $200/hr as an add-on with any inflatable or package. 31–80 kids: $599/hr standalone or $350/hr add-on. 80+ kids: from $800/hr standalone or from $650/hr add-on. Final pricing is confirmed manually.
What is included with a foam party rental?
The foam machine, foam solution, and our operator running the foam are included. You provide a clear grass area, a standard water source with hose access, and power. Setup suitability is confirmed before booking.
What is the Inflatable Foam Pit option?
A compact inflatable foam pit option for kids' parties and backyard-style events. The pit is 13 ft × 13 ft with 3 ft side walls and a 6 ft back wall, creating a contained foam play area for kids to enjoy. It is outdoor use only, needs water and power access, and foam solution is included based on your booking. Adult supervision is required, and weather and setup suitability are confirmed before the event.
Are foam parties for adults too?
No. Our foam parties are for children's events only — they are not available for adult events or events serving alcohol. A responsible adult aged 19+ must actively supervise at all times.
What do I need to provide for a foam party?
A clear, level grass area, a standard water source with hose access, and power. Kids should wear clothes that can get wet, and eye-sensitive children may want goggles. We confirm setup details with you before the event.
Where do you offer foam parties?
Foam parties work best across the South Shore — Bridgewater, Lunenburg, Mahone Bay, Chester, Liverpool, Shelburne, Yarmouth, Digby — plus Halifax, Dartmouth, and Bedford. Other Nova Scotia locations are confirmed case by case based on travel and setup logistics.
Can I add a foam party to an inflatable rental?
Yes — that's the best value. As an add-on with any inflatable or package, foam party pricing starts at $200/hr for up to 30 kids instead of the $349/hr standalone rate.
